summary.one_liner: NetNewsWire is a free, open-source feed reader for macOS and iOS that supports RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, and RSS-in-JSON.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes NetNewsWire as a feed reader for macOS and iOS that handles RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, and RSS-in-JSON formats. It points users to GitHub for bug reports and feature requests and to a community forum for discussion and help. It explains the contribution process: contributors should ask before starting a pull request. It also gives build instructions for developers, including a setup.sh script or manual steps to create a local DeveloperSettings.xcconfig for code signing. The README states that a build made this way runs without a paid developer account. In that build, iCloud, Feedly, and Reader View are disabled because the required API keys cannot be shared.
use_cases: read RSS and Atom feeds on a Mac or iPhone
follow blogs and news sites in one app
build NetNewsWire from source in Xcode
contribute to an open-source macOS/iOS app
how_to_run: cd into the NetNewsWire directory and run: chmod +x setup.sh
run ./setup.sh and answer the prompts to create DeveloperSettings.xcconfig
or manually create SharedXcodeSettings/DeveloperSettings.xcconfig next to the repo folder
open NetNewsWire.xcodeproj in Xcode and build
notable: Supports RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, and RSS-in-JSON
Builds without a paid Apple developer account, using a local xcconfig for code signing
Includes a setup.sh script to generate developer signing settings
Community forum and a Contributing page that asks contributors to discuss PRs first
caveats: Builds made without the developer's API keys have iCloud, Feedly, and Reader View disabled
Contributors are asked to raise an idea before starting a pull request
